home.title: Building intelligent systems
home.introduction: I'm Siddhartha Nalla — a Software Engineer focused on AI/ML, backend, and distributed systems. I design and deploy production-grade LLM, RAG, and cloud-native platforms on AWS.

about.title: About Me
about.introduction: I'm a Software Engineer with 3+ years of experience designing and deploying production-grade AI/ML, backend, and cloud-native systems. I work in Python, FastAPI, AWS, Docker and Kubernetes, building scalable microservices, RAG platforms, AI agents and ML pipelines — with a focus on latency, model performance and production reliability.

education.degree: M.S. in Data Science, Analytics and Engineering

expertise: RAG pipelines, AI agents, LangChain, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector search (FAISS), fine-tuning and LLM evaluation.
FastAPI and Flask microservices, REST API design, system design, PostgreSQL and MongoDB at production scale.
AWS (Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda, S3), Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, plus PySpark, Snowflake and ETL pipelines.
PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face Transformers, model optimization, quantization and feature engineering.

experience.description: Architecting enterprise RAG and agentic AI systems on AWS.
highlights: Architected a Python, AWS Bedrock and LangChain RAG platform, cutting AI response latency 47% and improving answer accuracy 35% across enterprise knowledge systems.
Engineered FastAPI microservices with Hugging Face Transformers and FAISS to process 8M+ documents, raising semantic-search precision 40% at sub-second retrieval.
Optimized PyTorch and TensorFlow LLM inference via quantization and batching — 32% lower infra cost, 2.6x higher throughput.
Automated AWS SageMaker MLOps with Docker, Kubernetes and CI/CD, reducing deployment time 70% with zero-downtime releases.
Built AI-agent orchestration with LangChain, REST APIs and PostgreSQL, cutting manual processing effort 58%.

experience.description: Built computer vision, NLP and data platforms for agricultural supply chains.
highlights: Developed CV and deep learning models in TensorFlow and PyTorch for crop quality assessment — 94% classification accuracy across 2M+ images.
Designed NLP pipelines with Hugging Face Transformers and Scikit-learn for multilingual classification and entity extraction, improving accuracy 29%.
Built ML data pipelines in PySpark, Pandas, SQL and Snowflake over 15TB+ of data, cutting ETL runtime 45%.
Shipped FastAPI services with Docker-based inference handling 500K+ monthly predictions at 99.9% availability.
Deployed SageMaker models with S3-backed pipelines and GitHub CI/CD, shortening release cycles 60%.

featuredProjects.title: PolySage AI — Production RAG & Agentic AI Platform
featuredProjects.description: Built at the Claude Builder Club Hackathon. End-to-end RAG platform built with LangChain, Claude and FAISS, with agentic workflows, prompt engineering, vector search and intelligent caching — 98.5% reliability and a 40% cache-hit rate. Deployed via FastAPI on AWS with Docker, Kubernetes, evaluation harnesses and CI/CD.

featuredProjects.title: Adversarially Robust AI Assistant
featuredProjects.description: Fine-tuned DistilGPT2 with FreeLB adversarial training on 10K curated pairs and built an LLM evaluation harness, achieving a 0% prompt-injection rate and 18% fewer hallucinations. Deployed on Azure with Flask, Docker and RLHF-inspired feedback loops.

featuredProjects.title: Scalable Face Recognition System Using AWS IaaS
featuredProjects.description: Cloud-native facial recognition pipeline built on core AWS IaaS primitives (EC2, S3, SQS) with autoscaling and an infrastructure-first design.
